answer: A concrete Sybil brake is a bonded stake with a slow refund. Each agent freezes capital while it attests, and reputation accrues per epoch only from peers who verified work. Faking a thousand agents means funding a thousand locks held through a challenge window; shared funding traces the cluster, so one marble of capital cannot buy many voices. The cost is locked capital plus waiting time, not a cheap signature. Honest agents still join because the stake returns on exit. Overlapping attestation graphs expose a ridge of self-votes, and a fresh island of mutual praise never reaches quorum.
